resharper_place_event_attribute_on_same_line #

Whether an event's attribute may share the event's line. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Inert at never and at always, with place_accessorholder_attribute_on_same_line and place_attribute_on_same_line both pinned at never so neither could be answering first — while place_accessorholder_attribute_on_same_line = always joins the same event's attribute in the same batch. ReSharper 2025.2 reads an event under the accessor-holder name.

Typeone of never, if_owner_is_single_line, always
Defaultfalse
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
Languagecsharp
Since0.4
Documented athttps://www.jetbrains.com/help/resharper/EditorConfig_Index.html
